description:
Multiple technical identifiers appear unquoted in doc comments, triggering clippy::doc_markdown warnings. Affects pkix-path/src/lib.rs and pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:

pkix-path/src/lib.rs:
- line 87: 'BasicConstraints cA=TRUE' — BasicConstraints, cA
- line 92: 'KeyUsage keyCertSign' — KeyUsage, keyCertSign  
- line 120: 'TBSCertificate' should be backtick-quoted
- line 153: 'SubjectAltName' should be backtick-quoted
- line 288: 'TBSCertificate' in trait doc
- line 289: 'BitString' in trait doc
- line 621: 'TBSCertificate' in validate_path doc

pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:
- line 330: 'CRLNumber', line 362: 'BaseCRLNumber'
- lines 384-388: 'cRLSign', 'KeyUsage' repeatedly
- line 407: 'CRLReason', line 417: 'IssuingDistributionPoint', line 420: 'SubjectInfoAccess'
- line 435: 'BasicConstraints'

Fix: wrap each technical term in backticks. This is a rustdoc convention that enables in-doc linking and improves readability.
title: doc_markdown: technical terms not backtick-quoted across all in-scope files
